sentences.text: Prasanta Das & Anr vs Union Of India & Ors on 18 July, 2023

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 16
18.07.2023
 Ct. No.10
 b.das
 Wpa 16556 of 2019
 Prasanta Das & Anr.
 Vs.
 Union of India & Ors.
 Mr. Jayanta Sengupta
 Ms. Shebatee Datta ...for the petitioners.
 Ms. Manika Roy
 Mr. Soumalya Chakraborty ...for Nhai.
None appears for the State respondents.
Heard learned counsels for the petitioners and the National Highways Authority of India.
The petitioners are aggrieved by the quantum of compensation granted to them for acquisition of their land.

The petitioners seek to file an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the 5 th respondent and prays for direction upon the said respondent to consider the application at the earliest.

Upon consideration of the submission made on behalf of the parties, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to submit an application under Section 3G(5) of the Act of 1956 before the 5th respondent within 14 days from date.

The 5 th respondent is directed to take necessary steps for consideration and disposal of the application within two months from the date of receipt thereof upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioners, in accordance with law.
The decision taken by the authority shall be communicated to the petitioners within a week thereafter.
